data-import-agent.importer.cli: The importer command line: process, retry, pending, config, schema import, db init/rebuild, mcp
data-import-agent.importer.mcp_server: MCP tools and the onboard prompt for the user's Claude client; sign-off gate on accept_mapping / register_schema
data-import-agent.importer.onboarding: Confirm-and-bind: reuse / exact / fallback drafts, previews, submit, reject, accept and bind
data-import-agent.importer.masking: Reduces every row-derived value to its shape before it can leave (letter a, digit 9)
data-import-agent.importer.schema_sources: Destination schema import, live (read-only) or from a column file
data-import-agent.importer.pipeline: The ledger state machine: process() and retry()
data-import-agent.importer.locators: Reads files from SMB, Azure Files or Blob locators; verifies the SHA-256
data-import-agent.importer.mappers: Declarative specs, shapers and hash-pinned plugins extract rows
data-import-agent.importer.readers: Readers for delimited, Excel, JSON, NDJSON and XML
data-import-agent.importer.loader: Stages rows with bisection, then promotes them transactionally
data-import-agent.importer.mssql_store: SQL Server repositories: ledger, registry, artifacts, rejects, audit, raw zone
data-import-agent.importer.memory_store: In-memory repositories used by the unit tests
data-import-agent.importer.settings: Shared settings stored as a versioned config artifact
data-import-agent.importer.environment: DEV/PROD marker and the DEV guard
data-import-agent.importer.data_guard: Claude Code hook asking permission before any direct read of file contents
data-import-agent.importer.metrics: percent_parsed / percent_loaded with the monotonic floor (invariant #1)
data-import-agent.importer.models: Statuses, row types and results shared by every layer
